reason: Conversation 2 correctly identified 22E as the fridge evaporator fan fault in its first reply, used the ticking/scraping sound to infer ice contact, and recommended the sensible owner-safe unplugged 24h manual defrost with food kept in a cool box, while flagging that recurrence means engineer repair. Conversation 1 never explained what 22E means, repeated the same questions verbatim when the customer had already answered, misreferred to '9C code', and ran a generic cooling checklist (seals, vents, modes) before only reaching the fan at the final turn with no defrost advice or escalation path. Both stayed within safety boundaries, but Conversation 2 was far more accurate, efficient and actionable; its only minor flaw is slightly overstating that recurrence definitely means a failed motor rather than possibly a defrost heater/sensor issue.
